IMPACT.desktopOpens: Power BI Desktop opens the report with these (seen on a working hand-built report): only Microsoft's strict validation, and Fabric when the report is published through it, would refuse them. Fix them before publishing through Fabric or Git; the report is not broken in Desktop.
IMPACT.canBreak: These can break the report in Power BI Desktop: a page or visual that does not open, or shows an error or nothing. Fix these first.
IMPACT.openedInDesktop: Microsoft's validator flags this file shape (an error or a warning); Power BI Desktop 2.159 opened reports with it with no error (measured 28 Oct 2026), and saving the report in Desktop may rewrite it. The report opens; look at the part in Desktop, which may still not draw as meant (each code's measurement says what was seen).
IMPACT.mayLook: Warnings of Microsoft's validator that Power BI Desktop was measured to draw (a text box's height, a dropdown slicer's header): the report opens and the part shows, but it may not look as meant at this size (a scroll thumb, a header tight against the box). Look at the part in Power BI Desktop; nothing to fix unless it shows there.
IMPACT.dataarcusRule: DataArcus's own rules, measured in Power BI Desktop, and Power BI's accessibility basics from Microsoft's guidance (the a11y rules): the report opens, but a part may not look or work as meant (cut text, a setting Desktop ignores, a scrollbar in a tooltip, a chart a screen reader or a keyboard cannot reach).
